relevance.rationale: The folio's Bring chapter builds a faithful icosahedral A_5 action on the categorical base and reads Bring's curve through Klein's icosahedral solution of the quintic (klein-bring-icosahedral-bridge), while cyclotomic-boundary-at-keystone records an E_8 Coxeter-marks coincidence at the S_5 keystone and flags the link as unproven. This paper carries the classical statement joining those two: the automorphism group of the configuration of 120 tritangent planes of Bring's curve is W(E_8)/{±1} (Coble's G_{8,2}), and §2 is a self-contained account of the standard icosahedron -> E_8 construction, with Bring's curve and Fricke's octavic curve as its algebraic-geometry appearance. That is a citable Bring<->E_8 link the folio currently has none of. Important scope note: it does NOT bear on QOU's coincidence, which is about quantum dimensions of S_5 classes equalling E_8 Coxeter marks — a different statement. The paper's own new content (E_8 from X(13) via PSL(2,13) invariant theory, Thm 1.1/1.2/1.4, and the explicit construction of X(13)) has no QOU consumer. Corpus-grep: no ref() entry; references.ts has bring1786 and a 'Bring's curve' entry but nothing on E_8/tritangent planes/X(13).

keyResults.locator: §1, p.7 (third consequence of Thm 1.1; attributed to Coble [7] p.356)
keyResults.statement: The automorphism group of the configuration of 120 tritangent planes of Bring's curve is W(E_8)/{±1}, of order 2^13·3^5·5^2·7.
keyResults.useForFolio: The one classical, citable statement tying Bring's curve to E_8. Belongs as a remark next to the folio's unproven E_8-Coxeter-marks coincidence, explicitly flagged as a DIFFERENT E_8 appearance, so the coincidence is not silently upgraded by association.

keyResults.locator: §2 'Standard construction: from the icosahedron to E8'
keyResults.statement: Self-contained account of the classical icosahedron -> E_8 root lattice construction, listing Bring's curve and Fricke's octavic curve among E_8's appearances and their common origin in the resolution of the quintic.
keyResults.useForFolio: A single citable source for the icosahedron/quintic/Bring nexus the folio's klein-bring-icosahedral-bridge narrates without references.

proposedActions.rationale: Orphan; the Bring<->E_8 statement is currently unsourced anywhere in the folio.

Not a cite-in-block on the coincidence itself: attaching this citation directly to the E_8-marks paragraph would read as evidence for a claim it does not support. The honest artifact is a remark recording the classical Bring/W(E_8) fact and stating explicitly that it is a distinct E_8 appearance from the quantum-dimension coincidence.
